body.title: Migrate review boundary and client assertions
body.summary: Capture focused baseline and assertion map; align review-specific labels, lifecycle wiring, in-daemon client and MCP checks with exact unavailable responses. Move valid generic transport assertions to supported or explicit test-only handlers.
acceptanceChecks: Retired design/code surfaces reject with exact current family response before poisoned-argument reads, providers or IO; no synthetic success on review-named surfaces.
Progress/done, synchronous throws, cancellation/drain and cwd/repo lookup retain equivalent positive controls on supported/test-only generic methods.
Review-only label expectations change without weakening active model-role tier assertions or modifying production review/RPC classification.
Record baseline and old-assertion→current-control mapping; preserve meaningful assertions rather than skipping/deleting suites.
